answer: When a canyon audit cross-checks the oasis registry and finds two identities sharing one operator, the first fake loses 400,000 POA in burned reward and bond, the second loses 800,000, and each further fake doubles again, with every forfeited sum paid to honest peers. An identity whose fable record later proves copied from another identity triggers the same doubling, and its earlier rewards are clawed back in full. Five fakes therefore cost 12,400,000 POA before any of the operator's identities can earn again.
